+/**
+ * Build the pathname for a standalone session URL while preserving any base
+ * path the app is deployed under (e.g. `/app/session/<id>` stays under
+ * `/app` instead of being reset to `/session/<id>`). With no session id,
+ * returns the base path (or `/` at the root).

+export function buildSessionPathname(

+  sessionId: string | undefined,
+): string {

discussion_comments.comment_body:
**[Critical]** A deployment base path ending in a `session` segment (or a pathname of `…/session/` with an empty id, which `[^/]+` rejects) breaks the write/parse round-trip — Failure scenario: deploy the shell under a base path whose final segment is `session` (e.g. `https://host/app/session/`), or land on `/app/session/` manually. On load `getSessionIdFromUrl` finds no match, so the app starts sessionless; the user then selects a session and `replaceStandaloneSessionUrl` calls `buildSessionPathname('/app/session/', 'real-id')`, which (verified by probe) produces `/app/session/session/real-id`. On refresh or when the URL is shared, `getSessionIdFromUrl` in `main.tsx` (`/\/session\/([^/]+)/`, unanchored, first match) parses back the literal string `session` as the session id, so the app tries to resume a nonexistent session named `session` instead of `real-id`. The writer (greedy, last match) and the parser (first match) disagree structurally; before this PR the writer always reset to `/session/<id>`, which parsed correctly, so this diff is what makes the broken round-trip reachable.

Suggested fix (spans two files, shown as regular code): make the parser agree with the writer by anchoring `getSessionIdFromUrl` to the *last* occurrence —

```ts
// main.tsx
window.location.pathname.match(/\/session\/([^/]+)\/?$/)
```

—and/or have `buildSessionPathname` treat a trailing `/session` / `/session/` base segment as part of the session route rather than the base. Add a test covering `buildSessionPathname('/app/session', 'new')` plus a parse-back assertion to lock the round trip.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

**[Critical]** 当部署基础路径以 `session` 段结尾（或路径名为 `…/session/`、id 为空——`[^/]+` 不匹配空段）时，写入/解析的往返会断裂——失败场景：将 Web Shell 部署在最后一个路径段为 `session` 的基础路径下（如 `https://host/app/session/`），或手动访问 `/app/session/`。加载时 `getSessionIdFromUrl` 无匹配，应用以无会话状态启动；用户随后选择会话，`replaceStandaloneSessionUrl` 调用 `buildSessionPathname('/app/session/', 'real-id')`，（已经探针验证）产出 `/app/session/session/real-id`。刷新或分享该 URL 后，`main.tsx` 中的 `getSessionIdFromUrl`（`/\/session\/([^/]+)/`，未锚定、取首个匹配）会把字面量 `session` 解析为 session id，应用因此尝试恢复一个名为 `session` 的不存在会话，而非 `real-id`。写入端（贪婪、取最后匹配）与解析端（取首个匹配）在结构上不一致；本 PR 之前写入端总是重置为 `/session/<id>`，可以正确解析，因此正是本 diff 使该断裂往返变为可达。

建议修复（跨两个文件，故用普通代码块）：让解析端与写入端一致，将 `getSessionIdFromUrl` 锚定到最后一次出现——

```ts
// main.tsx
window.location.pathname.match(/\/session\/([^/]+)\/?$/)
```

——和/或让 `buildSessionPathname` 将以 `/session` / `/session/` 结尾的基础路径段视为会话路由而非基础路径。新增覆盖 `buildSessionPathname('/app/session', 'new')` 的测试及解析回读断言，锁定该往返。

</details>

**[Critical]** `%repo_url%` can never resolve — GitLab's `GET /todos` does not return `project.web_url`.

`Entities::Todo` exposes `project` via `Entities::ProjectIdentity`, which exposes exactly `id`, `description`, `name`, `name_with_namespace`, `path`, `path_with_namespace`, `created_at` — no `web_url`. gitbeaker's own type agrees: `TodoSchema.project: Pick<SimpleProjectSchema, 'id' | 'name' | 'name_with_namespace' | 'path' | 'path_with_namespace'>`. The hand-written `Todo` interface (line 32) declares `web_url: string` and the `as unknown as Todo[]` cast at line 141 discards gitbeaker's typing, so the compiler never objects.

Since `buildMetadata` falls back with `vars[key] ?? match`, `undefined` yields the literal token: every agent turn receives `URL: %repo_url%`.

Verified by editing `makeTodo()` to the real GitLab shape and re-running the suite:
```
AssertionError: expected 'REPO: owner/repo | URL: %repo_url% | …'
                to be 'REPO: owner/repo | URL: https://gitlab.com/owner/repo | …'
```
The suite is green today only because the fixture invents a field the API never sends (see the comment on `GitlabAdapter.test.ts`).

```suggestion
        repo_url: ((this.config as GitlabConfig).baseUrl || 'https://gitlab.com').replace(/\/+$/, '') + '/' + chatId,
```

**[Critical]** `MergeRequests.show` called with wrong arguments — gitbeaker's signature is `show(projectId, mergerequestIId: number, options?)`, where `mergerequestIId` is the **second positional argument** (a number), not an options key. This passes `{ mergeRequestIId: todo.target.iid }` as the second arg (an object), which gets coerced to `[object Object]` in the URL template: `projects/owner/repo/merge_requests/[object Object]` — guaranteed 404.

— Failure scenario: first-contact on an MR with no notes → 404 → catch sets `description = ''` → same silent message loss as the Issue path.

```suggestion
      const mr = await this.api.MergeRequests.show(chatId, todo.target.iid);
```

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

`MergeRequests.show` 参数错误——gitbeaker 签名是 `show(projectId, mergerequestIId: number, options?)`，`mergerequestIId` 是第二个位置参数（数字），不是选项键。这里把 `{ mergeRequestIId: ... }` 作为第二个参数（对象），在 URL 模板中被转为 `[object Object]`，必定 404。

</details>

discussion_comments.comment_body:
**[Suggestion]** Caller-supplied `sessionId` silently discarded on `sessionScope: 'single'` attach — when `sessionScope` is `'single'` and a session already exists, the bridge's `spawnOrAttach` takes the attach fast path and never calls `doSpawn`, so `req.sessionId` is silently discarded. The caller receives the existing session's ID without any warning that their requested ID was ignored.

Failure scenario: caller sends `{"sessionId": "550e8400-...", "sessionScope": "single"}` when a single-scope session exists → bridge attaches to existing session → response returns existing ID → caller sends prompts to a session with different state/history than intended.

Suggested fix: when `requestedSessionId` is provided and `sessionScope` resolves to `'single'`, either return 400 (the two are semantically contradictory) or force `sessionScope` to `'thread'`.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

**[Suggestion]** 当 `sessionScope` 为 `'single'` 且会话已存在时，bridge 的 `spawnOrAttach` 走 attach 快速路径，从不调用 `doSpawn`，因此调用方提供的 `sessionId` 被静默丢弃。建议：当提供了 `requestedSessionId` 且 `sessionScope` 为 `'single'` 时，返回 400 或强制 `sessionScope` 为 `'thread'`。

</details>

**[Critical]** Parse every page returned by `gh api --paginate`

For a PR with more than one page of inline comments, `gh api --paginate` emits a separate JSON array for each page. `ghApiAll` currently feeds the concatenated arrays to one `JSON.parse`, which throws at the second page, so the status report is never written for the discussion-heavy PRs this helper targets. Add `--slurp` and flatten the page arrays, or parse a strict per-page/NDJSON form, and cover a multi-page response in the helper tests.

**[Critical]** `findMetaTrigger` uses `lastReadAt` (from the notification's `last_read_at`) as the lower-bound time filter for trigger events, while `fetchNewComments` (line 595) correctly uses `windowSince` (the bot cursor's `lastProcessedAt`). The problem: `markNotificationsAsRead` at line 260 calls `PUT /notifications` which is a **global** operation — it sets `last_read_at` on **all** threads in the inbox, not just the ones in the current batch. — Failure scenario: Poll at T1 processes a `comment` notification for issue #42. `markNotificationsAsRead(T1)` sets `last_read_at = T1` on every thread including an unread `review_requested` notification for PR #99. New activity bumps PR #99. Next poll fetches it. `findMetaTrigger` checks the review event at `created_at = T0`: `T0 <= lastReadAt (T1)` → filtered out. Review request silently dropped. `dispatchedEvents` does not catch this because the event was never dispatched. — Fix: use `ctx.windowSince` instead of `ctx.lastReadAt`, or rely solely on the `dispatchedEvents` dedup check.

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

`findMetaTrigger` 使用 `lastReadAt`（来自通知的 `last_read_at`）作为触发事件的时间下界过滤，而 `fetchNewComments` 正确使用 `windowSince`（bot 游标的 `lastProcessedAt`）。问题在于 `markNotificationsAsRead` 是**全局**操作——它会为收件箱中**所有**线程设置 `last_read_at`，不仅是当前批次的线程。当 bot 处理完一个批次后，其他线程的触发事件可能因为 `created_at <= lastReadAt` 被静默过滤，导致 review request 被永久丢弃。
